notes.title: Blackfall Development Update – Performance & AI Improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We know it's been some time since our last update, and we appreciate your patience and support. While we haven’t shared much recently, we want to assure you that development on Blackfall is moving full speed ahead!

Our current focus is on two key areas: performance optimization and AI improvements. As a rogue shooter, Blackfall relies heavily on fast-paced gameplay, and we want to ensure that every frame runs as smoothly as possible. We've been working on optimizing assets, refining rendering processes, and making sure the game runs efficiently across different hardware setups.

On the AI side, we are making enemies more dynamic and challenging, improving their decision-making processes and responsiveness. This will make combat encounters more engaging and rewarding, ensuring that every run feels fresh and exciting.

While there’s still work to be done, we’re excited about the progress we’ve made and can’t wait to show you more soon. Expect more updates as we get closer to the next milestone!

Thank you for your continued support, and stay tuned for more!
